Name: Tahpenes, Queen of Egypt
Summary: Tahpenes, queen of Egypt, was Pharaoh's wife, whose sister was given to Hadad the Edomite, and who weaned Hadad's son Genubath in Pharaoh's house.
KeyStory: Tahpenes, queen of Egypt, and Genubath.
RelatedPeople: Hadad, Prince of Edom; Genubath, Son of Hadad
LifeLesson: A queen's household sheltered the very child who would trouble Israel.
